cohort: The study included 208 cases and 288 controls, all women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP), comparing those with late stillbirth to those with live birth.
finding: Poor antenatal care, birth weight below 2000gms, and a high BW/PW ratio were significantly associated with a higher risk of late stillbirth.
birth_weight: Birth weight less than 2000g was identified as a significant factor associated with stillbirth.
